verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a hands-on community report that the Ollama app's "Multimodal ... support works as expected," which implies image-plus-text input works. No first-party documentation in the pack describes vision-language models, image inputs via the API or CLI, or which models support vision. The image-generation blog post is about producing images, not understanding them, so it does not count. Missing for 10: first-party docs on vision model support, documented image input in the API, CLI and SDKs, a list of supported vision-language models, and corroborating benchmarks or detailed hands-on reports.
